label: Gemini (spot)
terms_note: Public market-data endpoints only (no API key). The docs are HTML only (no OpenAPI; the only machine-readable description Gemini publishes is an AsyncAPI document for the WebSocket feed). Public REST is limited to 120 requests per minute ('we recommend that you not exceed 1 request per second'). /v1/symbols answers a bare list of strings; /v2/candles answers positional rows newest first with millisecond times and ignores any count. An unknown symbol answers 404 {"error":"no ticker data for NOPEUSD"} (live 2026-10-01).

list_markets.note: Every trading symbol in Gemini's lower-case form (btcusd, ethbtc); base/quote are not in this list (see the symbol details page). Paged locally; `query` is a substring of the symbol.

get_ticker.note: volume is the 24h volume in the base currency (the first key of the volume object, e.g. BTC for btcusd).

get_candles.note: interval is Gemini's time frame: 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1hr, 6hr, 1day. Candles come newest first; the newest `limit` are returned.

not_offered.me: Private endpoints need an API key and an HMAC-SHA384 signature over a base64 payload (X-GEMINI-APIKEY/X-GEMINI-PAYLOAD/X-GEMINI-SIGNATURE); public-data entry only.
not_offered.get_balances: POST /v1/balances needs an API key with the Fund Manager or Trader role; public-data entry only.
not_offered.list_orders: POST /v1/orders needs an API key with the Trader role; public-data entry only.
not_offered.place_order: POST /v1/order/new needs an API key and spends money; not mapped in this public-data entry.
not_offered.cancel_order: POST /v1/order/cancel needs an API key; not mapped in this public-data entry.
